chapter: Booker T, the brass bands and the Pelican band
title: Pelican band members and Dawson moving from guitar to bass
summary: Dawson lists Edward Clem, Willie Warner and Frankie Dusen, says he played guitar with Bob Lyons on bass, and that after Clem and Lyons fell out he was put on bass; Emile O'Reilly took over guitar.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Edward Clem, who was the trumpet player, the leader.
Willie Warner was the clarinetist. Franky Dooson, who was the trombone player.
I think the fella's name now on the drum, a little dog fella. Just can't think of his name right now. But I know I was, Bob Lyons was playing bass and I was playing guitar.
So you started on this guitar playing?
And after Bob Lyons and Edward Clem had a falling out, Edward put me on the bass.
Well, who played the guitar then?
Uh, he got, uh, they had, uh, Emile O'Reilly.
